summary: Azorius portal control: bounce and blink odd gate artifacts until Heliod opens a flash-speed burst turn and the token board takes over.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Literal portal artifacts, two transforming gateways, Tezzeret's activation discount, Prototype Portal copies, and artifact blink form a real engine.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Portal of Sanctuary, Teleportation Circle, Conjurer's Closet, Planar Incision, Another Round, and Venser repeatedly cross creatures and artifacts between zones.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Its default posture is to pass with mana up, answer the most relevant permanent with bounce or exile, and only commit heavier engines after the table slows down.

tags.name: flash
tags.reason: Heliod's back face, Emergence Zone, Whitemane Lion, Portal Manipulator, and foretell on Depart the Realm let the deck play almost entirely on the opponent-facing half of the turn cycle.

tags.name: etb effects
tags.reason: The bounce and blink package re-fires Aether Channeler, Firemane Commando, Portal to Phyrexia, and the other portal permanents.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Portal Manipulator, Firemane Commando, Coercive Portal, and Phyrexian Portal all ask the table to bargain or attack elsewhere instead of just removing everything.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Chrome Host Seedshark, Essence of Orthodoxy, Commence the Endgame, Tiller of Flesh, Multiversal Recruitment, and Xerex Strobe-Knight create the board that actually closes games.

tags.name: battles
tags.reason: The deck runs two useful battles and has flyers and tokens to flip them, but they support the engine rather than define it.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Gate to the Aether and Mirror of Life Trapping add uncertainty, but the deck is not a full chaos shell.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: The mana package exists to reach the expensive portals, but it is support rather than the deck's identity.

tags.name: spell copy
tags.reason: Invasion of Vryn and See Double can copy the right spell at the right moment, but the list is not primarily a copy deck.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Abduction steals a creature and Portal to Phyrexia reanimates from opposing graveyards, but theft is incidental.
